# Trafy Community

> Trafy Community is a community-driven learning and hiring platform. Members
> build skills through creator- and institution-authored courses (video, text,
> and live sessions), prove those skills with timed assessments, collaborate
> in study groups and realtime chat, and connect directly with employers
> hiring on the platform through a Kanban-style application pipeline and
> milestone-based contracts.

## Key pages

- [Course catalog](/learn): browse and enroll in published courses, free or paid, self-paced or in a scheduled cohort.
- [Job listings](/jobs): open roles posted directly by employers on the platform.
- [Institutions](/institutions): organizations (schools, bootcamps, companies) publishing courses under their own name.
- [Sign up](/sign-up): create an account via email one-time-code, no password.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- Course pages include `Course` and `AggregateRating` structured data (JSON-LD) reflecting real learner reviews.
- Most of the product (feed, chat, notifications, contracts) is behind authentication and intentionally excluded from indexing — see `/robots.txt`.
- This file and the site's SEO metadata are maintained alongside the codebase at each release; treat page content as the source of truth over any cached summary.
